verdict.rationale: Salv is an AML and compliance SaaS, so asking whether it ships an official CLI is a fair question. The evidence documents only a REST API, an OpenAPI/Postman definition, webhooks and Slack status updates; nothing shows a first-party command-line tool. An API that a developer could wrap in their own CLI is a building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
